assumptions: REFUTED as a universal about lineage graphs. It remains true of open software ecosystems, which is where its evidence came from.
attrs.evidence: REFUTED IN ITS SECOND HALF BY GPT-5.6, at the round after it was written. The over-inclusion half stands and is now LINEAGE-AFFECTEDNESS. The UNDER-inclusion half does not: R7 imported Rasheed et al.'s hidden-dependency result from open software ecosystems and treated it as an inherent property of lineage graphs. It is a property of ecosystems in which a build can read undeclared inputs. A closed, mediated world can attempt completeness BY CONSTRUCTION — mediated handles, a typed support edge per read, and a commit gate that seals them into the receipt — which is LINEAGE-COMPLETE, and Bazel's hermetic sandboxed actions demonstrate the discipline is achievable for builds. Given completeness, traversal becomes CONSERVATIVE rather than unsound: LINEAGE-REACH-CONSERVATIVE. R7's error was importing today's tooling limitations into an architecture that does not have to inherit them.
attrs.gap: DEMOTED AT R7.1, NOT REFUTED, and the distinction is this ledger's own: REFUTED means shown false by a construction that RUNS, and GPT-5.6 exhibited an achievable design rather than a counterexample. Over-claiming the refutation of an overclaim would be the same error a third time. The over-inclusion half is now LINEAGE-AFFECTEDNESS (KNOWN); the under-inclusion half is replaced by LINEAGE-COMPLETE (OPEN, an architecture goal) and LINEAGE-REACH-CONSERVATIVE (OPEN, conditional on it). Nothing in this tree mediates anything, so none of the three is implemented.
attrs.prior_art: SRC-VEX-EXPLOITABILITY and SRC-RASHEED-2026-HIDDEN-DEPS. Within this ledger: R5 recorded that `traverse descendants and prove absence` asks a bounded procedure for a universal negative, and that half stands.

readjudicated.method: carried_provisional — the source lane demoted it and the target has no new evidence either way
readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.review_focus: The instructive part is the direction of the mistake. R7 was correcting an overclaim of GPT-5.6's and over-corrected into a different overclaim — a negative universal about a class of system that has not been built.
attrs.statement: Traversing a lineage graph from an invalidated artifact yields a worklist that is neither sound nor complete for affectedness: it over-includes descendants that do not depend on the artifact's correctness, and under-includes dependents that carry no lineage edge.
